To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
The structure of epitaxial thin films can be described in terms of an elastic deformation of bulk structure, and that this deformation can be related to the magnetic properties.
the magnetic properties of epitaxial thin films can be understood in terms of a simple magnetoelastic model.

(1) the structure of thin films can be described in terms of elastic deformation of the corresponding bulk structure; (2) the magnetic properties are directly related to this structure; (3) a simple magnetoelastic model is sufficient to explain the magnetic behaviour.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the structural and magnetic properties of epitaxial thin films.
the structural properties of thin films and the influence of the structure on the magnetic properties.
the relationship between structure, electronic properties and magnetism in thin films.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, for the two systems studied here, the structure determines the magnetic properties.
the magnetic properties of thin films can be understood in terms of the structure and the magnetoelastic interactions.
the structure of the films is the key factor in determining the magnetic properties.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the structure of the films is not only determined by the growth mode, the deposition conditions, and the surface structure, but also by the substrate.

, in thin film systems, the magnetic properties can be understood in terms of the structure and that the magnetic properties are a consequence of the structure, rather than a consequence of the electronic structure.
, for a given magnetic material and a fixed growth mode, the magnetic properties are determined by the structure of the films and the magnetoelastic properties of the material.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the magnetic properties can be understood in terms of the structural distortions induced by the epitaxial strain, and that the magnetic anisotropies are determined by the symmetry of the distorted crystal structure.
a simple model, based on the bulk properties of the materials, can explain their magnetic properties.
the structural distortions induced by the epitaxial strain can have a strong influence on the magnetic properties of thin films and nanostructures, and can lead to unexpected properties.
